hooks.command:
PYTHON=$(which python3 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/bin/python3); PROJECT=$(pwd); [ -f "$PROJECT/.cc-forge/state.json" ] || exit 0; STAGE=$($PYTHON -c "import json; d=json.load(open('$PROJECT/.cc-forge/state.json')); print(str(d.get('current_stage','?')) + ' ' + d.get('stage_name',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo '?'); NEXT=$($PYTHON -c "import json; tasks=json.load(open('$PROJECT/.taskmaster/tasks/tasks.json'))['master']['tasks']; pending=[t for t in tasks if t.get('status') not in ['done','cancelled']]; t=pending[0] if pending else None; print('#' + str(t['id']) + ' - ' + t['title']) if t else print('all tasks complete')" 2>/dev/null || echo '?'); META=$($PYTHON -c "import json; m=json.load(open('$PROJECT/.taskmaster/tasks/tasks.json'))['master']['metadata']; print(str(m['completedCount']) + '/' + str(m['taskCount']))" 2>/dev/null || echo '?/?'); DATE=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d'); printf '
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  HERMES · %s · Stage %s
  %s
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  Tasks:  %s done
  Next:   %s
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
' "$(basename $PROJECT)" "$STAGE" "$DATE" "$META" "$NEXT"
